scripts.wasm: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" wasm-pack build wasm-frontend --target web --out-dir ../public/wasm --out-name actress_frontend
scripts.format: biome format --write src/data src/wasm tests playwright.config.ts astro.config.mjs lighthouserc.cjs package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.test:biome: biome ci src/data src/wasm tests playwright.config.ts astro.config.mjs lighthouserc.cjs package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.test:axe: npm run build && playwright test tests/axe.spec.ts
scripts.test:layout: npm run build && playwright test tests/layout-overflow.spec.ts
scripts.test:qa: npm run test:biome && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:run && npm run test:lighthouse:run
